¿Quién reparte primero? Al abrir la mesa: Who deals first? When the table opens everyone shakes the dice cup at once and slams it down: the highest die deals the first round. If there's a tie at the top, only the tied players shake again. The host can change this in More settings.

Aquí no se juega flor, matar cantos ni v: No flor, no killing calls and no automatic win by rondín here. You can turn off all calls when opening the table.

Cantos clásicos de esta mesa: ronda (par: This table's classic calls: ronda (pair), 1–4 by the card; rondín (three of a kind), 5; patrulla, also called patria (three in a row), 6; vigía (pair and an adjacent card), 7; registro (ace, knight, king), 8. Only the highest call, before playing your first card. You can play without calling it.
Corta si quieres. Elige con cuál número: Cut if you want. Pick which number to try your luck with.
El repartidor corta y elige su número. Y: The dealer cuts and picks a number. The cards are coming.

En cada reparto, quien reparte puede cor: Each round, the dealer can cut the deck once, face down, and picks whether to start from 1 or from 4: 1–2–3–4 or 4–3–2–1. Each hit scores the called number. No hits: bad deal, one point to the next player. Repeated numbers go back to the bottom before continuing.
En parejas o equipos de tres, los compañ: In pairs or teams of three, partners sit in alternate seats and share points and collected cards. Bots play the empty seats. A new friend takes a bot's seat; the rest watch until there's room.
Gana quien llegue primero a 24 puntos. S: The first to reach 24 points wins. There are 40 cards: ace, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, jack (10), knight (11) and king (12), in four suits. Suits don't change captures.
Juega una carta del mismo número que una: Play a card with the same number as one on the table to collect both and every consecutive card after it, with no gaps: after the 7 comes the jack. If nothing matches, your card stays on the table.
La última persona que recoge se lleva la: The last person to collect takes the leftover cards, with no clean-table points. On the count, each card above 20 scores in one-on-one or pairs, above 13 with three players, 10 with four individuals and 6 with six individuals. Teams of three use a base of 20. If several reach 24 on the count, it's settled starting from the first player.
Mesa completa. Entras cuando se libere u: Table full. You'll join when a seat opens up.
